# Frontend changes

For any change that affects the website's UI or user experience, use the
`frontend-design` skill to guide the implementation and review the result.
Before coding, establish a design direction grounded in this certification
flashcard app and its users; then check that the direction is intentional rather
than a generic template. After coding, review the changed experience against the
skill's guidance and improve it where needed, including responsive behavior,
keyboard focus, reduced motion, and visual accessibility.

Keep the review scoped to the affected frontend experience. Do not redesign
unrelated screens or apply this requirement to backend-only, data-only, or
infrastructure-only changes.
